final: WITH t AS (SELECT CASE WHEN WBC IS NULL THEN 'wbc_missing' WHEN WBC <= 6.5 THEN 'wbc_le_6_5' ELSE 'wbc_gt_6_5' END AS wb, COALESCE(CENTROMEA, 'missing') AS st, GOT - GPT AS ag, APTT - PT AS ap FROM Laboratory), g AS (SELECT wb, st, AVG(ag) AS ag_avg, AVG(ap) AS ap_avg FROM t GROUP BY wb, st) SELECT AVG(ag_avg) AS avg_ast_minus_alt, AVG(ap_avg) AS avg_aptt_minus_pt FROM g
